proposition.claim:
All printed hierarchy hypotheses hold on a compact conformal-dimension-zero space.

Natural Brownian occupation measure, including compactX restriction, is almost surely not doubling.

S'_n eventually empty a.s while bad tiles exist at every sufficiently fine scale, so Eq6.5 has positive left side and zero right side.

Diameter-near-full independent compact selections do not ensure compatible cores; minimum child averages cannot be copied globally with arbitrary unequal masses.

Allowed vertical carpet sets need not have any finite all-generation flatness constant.

Approximate-cell/boundary explanation, image normalization, strict modulus, parameter range and final endpoint require local correction.
